Put In Order

For teachers and tutors

About Put In Order

An ordering game with four kinds of rounds: numbers from smallest to biggest, Australian coins and notes from smallest to biggest, three days of the week in order, and three months in order.

How to play

  1. Look at the tiles.
  2. Tap or drag them into order.
  3. Check it.
